The individual described is **Vitali Hakko**, who was born in Tampere, Finland. The city of Tampere features the historic Pyynikki area and old wooden architecture. Vitali Hakko opened a hat shop in Tampere in the 1930s. When hats became less popular, he shifted the focus of his business to scarves and renamed the shop **Vakko**, which was derived from the initials of his own name (**V**itali), his sibling's name (**A**ino), and their surname (**Kko**). After expanding the business to other cities in the 1970s, he collaborated with his son in the 1980s to launch a new brand targeting a younger audience.

The name of this new brand is **Vakko Junior**.
